literal: Ruin if desired, without listening let one do, destroying if desired towards those who are capable, an offense.
translation: If one desires their own ruin, let them ignore advice and commit an offense against those capable of destroying them at will.
modern: தான் கெட்டுப்போக விரும்பினால், ஒருவன் அறிவுரைகளைக் கேட்காமல், நினைத்தவுடனே அழிக்க வல்லவர்களிடத்தில் பிழையைச் செய்யட்டும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the fatal consequences of offending powerful people. The phrase 'அடல் வேண்டின் ஆற்றுபவர்' refers to those who have the capability to destroy someone the moment they wish to do so. If a person truly wants to be ruined, the surest way is to ignore all good advice ('கேளாது') and commit an offense ('இழுக்கு') against such formidable individuals. The use of the optative 'செய்க' (let them do) acts as a strong, ironic warning against such foolish behavior.
